notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Tariel.
Tariel does not have summoning sickness.
At least one opponent has at least one creature in their graveyard.
description:
Activate Tariel to return a random creature from target opponent's graveyard to the battlefield.
Sacrifice the returned creature to Phyrexian Altar, triggering Thornbite Staff and untapping Tariel.
Repeat steps 1-2.
